    INFO SITE

    ⚽🔥 ARE YOU A PES 2021 FAN? THEN THIS BLOG IS FOR YOU! 🔥⚽ 🎮 Welcome to my PES 2021 STATISTICS SITE, a project created for all football and PES fans who want to take their game to an even higher level of realism and detail! 📊 Inside the blog, you will find a constantly growing database featuring: 🏆 ALL TEAMS listed on Transfermarkt 👤 ALL PLAYERS, from 1893 to the present day 📈 DETAILED PLAYER RATINGS AND STATISTICS 🎯 TEAM TACTICS, FORMATIONS AND PLAY STYLES 🎨 PLAYER FACES CREATED WITH THE PES EDITOR 📋 Faces also created using the BASE COPY METHOD 👟 PLAYER MOVEMENTS, ANIMATIONS AND ACCESSORIES ⚡ Technical and physical attributes for every player 📊 Detailed statistics designed to make each player as realistic and accurate as possible 💎 The goal is to create a real PES 2021 encyclopedia, where you can find everything you need to recreate historical teams, modern squads, legendary players and today's stars. 🔥 If you love PES, football history and player statistics, this is the place for you! 👉 SUBSCRIBE TO THE SITE 👉 FOLLOW ME AND STAY UPDATED 👉 SHARE THE PROJECT WITH OTHER PES 2021 FANS! ⚽ A project made by fans, for fans. 📊 PES 2021 — DATA, STATISTICS, HISTORY & REALISM. ❤️ JOIN THE COMMUNITY AND BE PART OF THE PROJECT!
